thread:
lee: Heads-up: release window in 20m, pipeline blocked on artifact manifest commit (job: publish-manifest). Deploy-bot shows repeated 503s from storage-proxy. Holding automatic promotion.

devops-bot: build-1789 attempted manifest commit -> 503 Service Unavailable x5, retry backoff triggered. Auto-promotion suspended. Logs: `storage-proxy: upstream_s3: 503`

anya: Any DB migrations? If yes we should abort promo.

lee: No migrations. It's a routes config + binary bump. Safe to fallback to last-promoted image for the window.

jen: Options: 1) wait (risk missing window), 2) rerun upload from eu-runner, 3) promote previous digest and follow up with patch. Recommend #3.

deploy-bot: Note: Manual promotion will set release.lock=manual and annotate `artifact_reupload_pending`. Auto-rollout will not resume until manual-unpause.

lee: I'll approve. @anya can you run the promote?

anya: Running `deployctl promote --tag rc-20240220 --image sha256:aa11bb22cc33 --reason "storage proxy commit failures"`

anya: promotion accepted, rc-20240220 -> sha256:aa11bb22cc33 now in staging. Canaries started.

devops-bot: Created INC-2024-62: "storage-proxy 5xx causing manifest commit failures" assigned infra. Priority P3.

lee: Good. Unholding promotion for the window. Follow-ups: queue reupload job in nightly run, add checksum verification, add storage-proxy rate-limit alert. I'll add to release notes and flag support.

jen: Monitoring metrics. Will escalate if error budget trend spikes.

lee: Closing — promoted last-good digest sha256:aa11bb22cc33, incident INC-2024-62 opened, patch reupload scheduled."
